documents.title: Upload Documents
documents.required: Identification documents and selfies are required by law.
documents.importantText: Uploading identification documents (front) and selfie is mandatory for all guests as required by law. If you do not wish to upload digitally, you can present the physical document directly at the hotel reception.
documents.lgpdDescription: Information about the mandatory collection of documents
documents.legalBasisText: The request for photo identification is not a hotel choice, but a legal obligation provided for in:
documents.decreeText: This decree regulates the General Tourism Law and establishes that accommodation facilities must maintain guest records with identification information, in accordance with current legislation.
documents.ordinance: Ordinance No. 1.129/2023 of the Ministry of Justice and Public Security
documents.ordinanceText: Determines that hotel establishments must register the complete identification of all guests, including:
documents.idDocument: Identification document (ID, Driver's License or Passport)
documents.stateLawsText: Several states and municipalities have specific legislation on guest control for public security purposes.
documents.lgpdComplianceText: It is important to clarify that the collection of this data is in compliance with the LGPD (Law No. 13.709/2018), specifically under the following legal bases:
documents.article7II: Art. 7, II - Compliance with legal or regulatory obligation by the controller
documents.article7IIText: When collection is necessary to comply with a legal obligation, consent is not required.
documents.article7VText: Processing is necessary for the execution of the accommodation contract.
documents.dataUsage: Your data will be used exclusively for the required legal purposes
documents.security: We implement technical and administrative security measures to protect data
documents.noSharing: Your data will not be shared with third parties, except when required by competent authorities
documents.storage: Information will be stored only for the legally established period
documents.rights: You have rights guaranteed by the LGPD, including access, correction and information about the processing of your data
documents.alternativesText: If you do not wish to upload the document photo digitally, you can:
documents.presentPhysical: Present the physical document directly at the hotel reception
documents.refusalText: We inform you that, in case of refusal to provide the documentation required by law, the hotel will not be able to carry out the accommodation, as we would be failing to comply with legal obligations and subject to administrative penalties.
